```tok
tok 1.0

pool BANK "Bank" {
  lane customer "Customer" {
    start start "Loan approval process"
    task receive "receive customer request for a loan amount"
    task approve "approve loan"
    task deny "deny loan"
    task feedback "send feedback to customer"
    end end "End"
  }

  lane risk "Risk Assessment" {
    task assess "invoke risk assessment Web service"
    xor decision "risk decision"
  }

  lane approver "Approver" {
    task approver "invoke approver Web service"
  }
}

flow start -> receive
flow receive -> assess
flow assess -> decision
flow decision -> approve "loan is small and low risk" when="loanAmount < 10000 and risk = 'low'"
flow decision -> deny "high risk" when="risk = 'high'"
flow decision -> approver "needs further review or amount >= 10000" when="reviewNeeded or loanAmount >= 10000"
flow approve -> feedback
flow deny -> feedback
flow approver -> feedback
flow feedback -> end
```
